title: Phoenix LiveView 1.2
summary: Phoenix LiveView 1.2 is a major release of the Elixir web framework's real-time UI library, enabling developers to build interactive server-rendered web applications with persistent WebSocket connections, reducing the need for client-side JavaScript.
problem_solved: Enables real-time, interactive web UIs with minimal JavaScript by leveraging server-side rendering and persistent connections.
why_valuable: Provides a more maintainable architecture for building real-time applications using Elixir's fault-tolerant concurrency model, with automatic UI updates over WebSockets.
